_comment: Read by core scripts/local-machinery.py at every session start. It inventories every carrier of behaviour in this brain (hooks, stop checks, MCP servers run from the brain, git hooks, scheduled jobs, extra plugins, skills, workflows, output styles, agents, commands, rule sections, scripts) and names each one that is neither core nor declared here. identity_tokens: words only THIS brain has (hosts, IPs, person, device and domain names) - an undeclared item containing none of them is reported as presumably general. instance: id or prefix -> {why, evidence: the instance token the item contains (checked), distinct_from: a core name it only resembles}; a general mechanism belongs in the core as a PR. alpha: id or prefix of a development checkout -> {kind (test: a real test phase, the core port waits for it, needs record = the file it writes its measurement to (the instrument creates it on its first run; written within record_days, default 7) or the URL / owner/repo#n where its result stands | unreleased: a clear core feature wired before its release, needs core_pr = the PR URL or owner/repo#n), until (YYYY-MM-DD), why}; past the date, without a kind, unreleased without core_pr, or a test whose record is not named, missing or silent, the start gets loud.
